about.lead: Anyone can open an AI tool. Almost no one knows what to do with it.
paragraphs: That’s the gap we built EDSCRIPT to close. We take people who can press buttons and turn them into people who make the calls — the story decision, the frame, the cut, the brand move — that no model makes for you.
We don’t teach prompts. We teach the eye behind them. Every course we run, filmmaking, design, podcasting, marketing, is built on one rule: story and craft come first, AI comes second, always.
about.vision: A generation of creators who command AI the way a director commands a set. In charge of every shot, every call, every outcome.
about.mission: Train directors, not operators. Hand people the judgment to lead AI, not the dependency to follow it.

programs.description: Specialized programs to help you learn, create, and lead with story and AI.

items.title: AI Filmmaking & Video Production
items.summary: Learn to think like a director. Write, shoot, generate and cut short films where every frame is a decision you made, and AI is the crew that helps you make it.
learn: Story structure, scripting and shot design
Cinematography, lighting and composition basics
AI video, image and voice tools in a real pipeline
Editing, pacing, colour and sound
items.outcome: A finished short film and a director’s reel for your portfolio.

items.title: Digital Marketing with Generative AI
items.summary: Plan campaigns that start with an insight, not a tool. Use generative AI to research, write, design and test faster, while you stay in charge of the strategy.
learn: Audience research and positioning
Campaign planning across paid, owned and social
AI-assisted copy, creative and ad variations
Measuring results and making the next call
items.outcome: A complete campaign plan with live creative you built yourself.

items.title: Content Creation & Social Media
items.summary: Build a voice people come back for. Learn to plan, shoot and edit content for every platform, and use AI to keep a steady output without losing what makes it yours.
learn: Finding your angle and content pillars
Short-form video: hooks, shooting and editing
Platform formats, algorithms and community
AI workflows for scripting, editing and repurposing
items.outcome: A content system and a month of published work.

items.title: Brand Storytelling & Creative Strategy
items.summary: Turn what a brand stands for into stories people remember. Learn the strategy behind great brands and use AI to explore ideas, not to replace them.
learn: Brand strategy, purpose and positioning
Narrative frameworks and messaging
Visual identity and tone of voice
Pitching creative ideas with confidence
items.outcome: A brand story and creative strategy deck for a real brief.

items.title: Podcasting, Hosting & Digital Media
items.summary: Find your voice and hold an audience. From the first idea to a published show, learn hosting, interviewing and production with AI tools that handle the heavy lifting.
learn: Show format, research and episode planning
Hosting, interviewing and on-mic presence
Recording, editing and audio clean-up
Publishing, clips and growing a listenership
items.outcome: A launched podcast pilot with promotional clips.

items.title: Applied AI for Business
items.summary: Use AI where it actually moves the business. Learn to spot the right problems, design practical workflows and lead the people who use them.
learn: Where AI helps, and where it doesn’t
Designing and automating everyday workflows
Data, prompts and evaluating outputs
Leading teams and change around AI
items.outcome: A working AI workflow for a real business process.
